description: The figure is a pie-style chart summarizing four categories or criteria associated with the referenced paper/benchmark, displayed as a circle divided into 4 slices of equal size (approximately 25% each). The top-left slice is labeled “Complexity” and is colored yellow/gold; the top-right slice is labeled “Instance” and is colored light blue; the bottom-right slice is labeled “Coverage” and is colored light green; and the bottom-left slice is labeled “Scalable Oversight” and is colored red. Each slice contains a small black icon near the center, and there are no numeric percentage labels shown inside the slices. Around the pie, there are four rounded rectangular callouts that appear to correspond to the quadrants: “Uncrushable” (near the yellow slice), “Unhackable” (near the blue slice), “General” (near the green slice), and “Auto-verifiable” (near the red slice). No legend is present, no slices are exploded or offset, and the segments appear arranged as four equal quadrants rather than ordered by size.
